core_facts.fact: For centuries, **consciousness** — how silent electromagnetic tissue turns light on your retina into ***'I SEE THAT WORD!'*** — was taboo in hard neuroscience, dismissed as an untestable mystery until **Stanislas Dehaene, Jean-Pierre Changeux, and Lionel Naccache** built a clean laboratory switch (**May 2006, *Trends in Cognitive Sciences*, SRC1; *Neuron* 2011, SRC2**).

How do you study pure consciousness scientifically? Hold the **physical word on the screen 100% constant** (say, a 43-millisecond flash of the word **LION**), and dial a **visual mask** milliseconds closer or further (**Del Cul, Baillet & Dehaene 2007, SRC3**) so on half the trials you swear the screen was **blank**, and on the other half the word **pops vividly into awareness**.

Look at what **fMRI, MEG, high-density EEG, and intracranial human electrodes** revealed during the **first ~200 milliseconds**: EVEN WHEN YOU SWEAR YOU SAW NOTHING (**Subliminal state**), the flashed word STILL travels up from the retina through **primary visual cortex (V1)**, the **visual word-form area**, and even nudges semantic/motor priming before **dying out locally**.

In **2006 (SRC1)**, Dehaene's team carved out a razor-sharp **3-State Taxonomy** that unified attention and consciousness: **(1) Subliminal** (weak masked bottom-up signal — never able to enter awareness); **(2) Preconscious** (STRONG unmasked sensory signal — like Simmons & Chabris's **Invisible Gorilla** or an un-attended ear! — rich in visual cortex yet blocked from broadcast because top-down frontoparietal attention is busy elsewhere!); and **(3) Conscious Access**.

What happens at **Conscious Access**? As you nudge mask delay step-by-step past **~50 milliseconds**, early visual cortex rises *smoothly and linearly* — and then around **270 to 300 milliseconds after the flash**, brain activity undergoes a sudden **ALL-OR-NONE NONLINEAR PHASE TRANSITION ('Global Ignition' / P3b wave)**.

In that ~300-ms ignition, restrained, coherent **long-range white-matter axonal loops** link sensory cortex reciprocally with **bilateral prefrontal and inferior parietal 'Global Workspace' hubs** — broadcasting that ONE piece of information simultaneously to **speech (Broca's), working memory, planning, and episodic memory** so you can *report it, hold it, and think about it*.

This Global Ignition signature gave coma clinics a **life-saving bedside tool** (King, Faugeras, Naccache & Dehaene): detecting long-range frontoparietal 'global oddball' sharing helps identify **minimally conscious patients** trapped inside unresponsive bodies.

And in **2023–2025**, Dehaene joined rival theorist **Giulio Tononi** (Integrated Information Theory, IIT) in **COGITATE (*Nature* 2025; Naccache, SRC4)** — neuroscience's landmark pre-registered **Adversarial Collaboration** across 256 subjects. Both theories faced tough surprises (GNW saw onset ignition yet weaker stimulus-*offset* prefrontal bursts; IIT missed sustained posterior gamma synchrony), proving consciousness is now **rigorous, falsifiable experimental science**.

wow_facts.fact: For the **first 200 milliseconds** after a word flashes on the display, your visual cortex reads its letters and even hints at its meaning **while 'You' are still 100% blind to it** — conscious sight only arrives when **~300-ms Global Ignition** broadcasts it across prefrontal-parietal workspace hubs.
wow_facts.why_surprising: You always live ~0.3 seconds behind your own eyes' first rough draft.

wow_facts.fact: Turn a masking dial smoothly in tiny 16-millisecond steps (Del Cul & Dehaene, SRC3): early visual cortex climbs in a **gentle straight line**, while conscious awareness snaps like a **cliff-edge light switch (0% to 100% bimodal 'all-or-none' ignition)**.
wow_facts.why_surprising: Consciousness isn't a dimmer knob; it's a phase transition like water snapping into ice.

wow_facts.fact: Dehaene's **3-State Map (SRC1)** ties **150 years of psychology** together in one diagram: **Zajonc's 1-ms flash = Subliminal**; **Simons's Invisible Gorilla & Cherry's Cocktail Party = Preconscious**; **300-ms frontoparietal broadcast = Conscious Access**.
wow_facts.why_surprising: Every classic blind-spot experiment in our 100-topic collection snaps onto one unified brain map.

wow_facts.fact: Instead of arguing from armchairs, Dehaene (GNW) and Tononi (IIT) signed their exact predictions in advance and let independent labs test 256 brains in **COGITATE (*Nature* 2025, SRC4)** — challenging BOTH theories publicly.
wow_facts.why_surprising: Science at its noblest: betting your life's theory against hard data in public.

misconceptions.myth: Unconscious processing is foolish or tiny — if you aren't conscious of a word or face, it stops at your eyeball.
misconceptions.truth: Dehaene et al. (SRC1, SRC2) proved unconscious waves extract word identity, numbers, and emotional cues deep into cortical hubs — what unconscious processing CANNOT do is **hold information across seconds in working memory or broadcast it flexibly across the whole brain**.

misconceptions.myth: Attention and consciousness are the exact same thing.
misconceptions.truth: Dehaene's **Preconscious vs Subliminal** split (SRC1) proved you can pay maximum top-down attention to a heavily masked subliminal word and **still see nothing** — attention is the *gatekeeper*, not consciousness itself.

misconceptions.myth: Your conscious workspace can broadcast three complex thoughts simultaneously.
misconceptions.truth: Because Global Ignition recruits the **single shared frontoparietal workspace highway**, locking one conscious thought onto the global stage temporarily blocks rival preconscious inputs ('attentional blink' for ~300–500 ms).

everyday_hooks: Experiencing the **'Attentional Blink'**: spot Target #1 in a fast stream, and for the next **300 milliseconds** while your Global Workspace broadcasts #1, Target #2 vanishes right in front of your open eyes.
Seeing how every mystery in psychology — **subliminal liking, invisible gorillas, split brains, and coma recovery** — clicks together inside Dehaene's Global Workspace.
Protecting your brain's **one-broadcast-at-a-time 300-ms stage**: give deep problems uninterrupted single-task focus so they ignite across your whole workspace.
